title: The Gate
synopsis: Thandeka refuses to accept that the man at her window is her son. Siyabonga proves he knows things only the dead would know, then tells her what opening the gate will cost her.
cliffhanger: A fourth vehicle arrives and Siyabonga implies there is something worse than his return that Thandeka does not yet know

shots.speaker: Thandeka
shots.dialogue: You are not my son. My son is dead.
shots.subtitle: You are not my son. My son is dead.
shots.action: Thandeka stands inside the gatehouse gripping the radio handset, staring through the window at the figure outside

shots.speaker: Siyabonga
shots.dialogue: You told the police I was at Uncle Mpho's that night. But I was with you.
shots.subtitle: You told the police I was at Uncle Mpho's that night. But I was with you.
shots.action: Siyabonga leans against the gatehouse window frame, his face calm in the dim emergency light

shots.speaker: Thandeka
shots.action: Thandeka's hand releases the radio handset and it swings on its coiled cord

shots.speaker: Thandeka
shots.subtitle: How do you know that?
shots.action: Thandeka stares at Siyabonga through the glass, her mouth barely moving

shots.speaker: Siyabonga
shots.dialogue: Open the gate now and I walk away after tonight. You never see me again.
shots.subtitle: Open the gate now and I walk away after tonight. You never see me again.
shots.action: Siyabonga straightens and steps back from the window, watching her

shots.speaker: Thandeka
shots.dialogue: And if I do not open it?
shots.subtitle: And if I do not open it?
shots.action: Thandeka moves toward the gate control panel, her hand hovering over the emergency lock

shots.speaker: Thandeka
shots.action: A second set of headlights appears in the distance behind the convoy, approaching fast

shots.speaker: Siyabonga
shots.dialogue: Then the man in that car will tell you what I did after I died.
shots.subtitle: Then the man in that car will tell you what I did after I died.
shots.action: Siyabonga turns away from the gatehouse and walks toward the approaching headlights
